mapper.select: SELECT spending_analysis_id AS spendingAnalysisId, user_id AS userId, analysis_period AS analysisPeriod, created_at AS createdAt FROM spending_analysis_tbl WHERE spending_analysis_id = #{spendingAnalysisId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT result.spending_category_id AS spendingCategoryId, category.category_name AS categoryName, result.spending_amount AS spendingAmount, result.spending_ratio AS spendingRatio, result.transaction_count AS transactionCount FROM spending_analysis_category_tbl result INNER JOIN spending_category_tbl category ON result.spending_category_id = category.spending_category_id WHERE result.spending_analysis_id = #{spendingAnalysisId} ORDER BY result.spending_amount DESC, result.transaction_count DESC, result.spending_category_id ASC

SELECT card_product_id AS cardProductId, card_name AS cardName, card_type AS cardType, card_description AS cardDescription, card_image AS cardImage, application, annual_fee AS annualFee FROM kb_card_product_tbl

SELECT card_benefit_id AS cardBenefitId, card_product_id AS cardProductId, spending_category_id AS spendingCategoryId, benefit_name AS benefitName, benefit_amount AS benefitAmount, benefit_rate AS benefitRate, monthly_limit AS monthlyLimit, minimum_spending_amount AS minimumSpendingAmount, benefit_description AS benefitDescription FROM card_benefit_tbl ORDER BY card_product_id, card_benefit_id

SELECT ft.transaction_id AS transactionId, ft.amount, ft.created_at AS createdAt, ft.spending_category_id AS spendingCategoryId, category.parent_category_id AS parentCategoryId FROM financial_transaction_tbl ft LEFT JOIN spending_category_tbl category ON ft.spending_category_id = category.spending_category_id WHERE ft.user_id = #{userId} AND ft.transaction_type IN ('PAYMENT', 'TRANSFER', 'SETTLEMENT') AND ft.transaction_status = 'SUCCESS' AND ft.created_at >= #{startAt} AND ft.created_at < #{endAt} ORDER BY ft.created_at ASC, ft.transaction_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card_recommendation_tbl ( spending_analysis_id, card_product_id, recommendation_rank, expected_benefit_amount, ai_recommendation_summary ) VALUES ( #{spendingAnalysisId}, #{cardProductId}, #{recommendationRank}, #{expectedBenefitAmount}, #{aiRecommendationSummary} )

INSERT INTO card_recommendation_detail_tbl ( card_recommendation_id, card_benefit_id, eligible_spending_amount, eligible_transaction_count, eligible_month_count, expected_benefit_amount ) VALUES
( #{detail.cardRecommendationId}, #{detail.cardBenefitId}, #{detail.eligibleSpendingAmount}, #{detail.eligibleTransactionCount}, #{detail.eligibleMonthCount}, #{detail.expectedBenefitAmount} )
mapper.select: SELECT recommendation.card_recommendation_id AS cardRecommendationId, recommendation.spending_analysis_id AS spendingAnalysisId, recommendation.card_product_id AS cardProductId, recommendation.recommendation_rank AS recommendationRank, recommendation.expected_benefit_amount AS expectedBenefitAmount, recommendation.ai_recommendation_summary AS aiRecommendationSummary, product.card_name AS cardName, product.card_type AS cardType, product.card_description AS cardDescription, product.card_image AS cardImage, product.application, product.annual_fee AS annualFee FROM card_recommendation_tbl recommendation INNER JOIN kb_card_product_tbl product ON recommendation.card_product_id = product.card_product_id INNER JOIN spending_analysis_tbl analysis ON recommendation.spending_analysis_id = analysis.spending_analysis_id WHERE recommendation.spending_analysis_id = #{spendingAnalysisId} AND analysis.user_id = #{userId} AND product.card_type = #{cardType} ORDER BY recommendation.recommendation_rank ASC, recommendation.card_recommendation_id ASC

SELECT recommendation.card_recommendation_id AS cardRecommendationId, recommendation.spending_analysis_id AS spendingAnalysisId, analysis.analysis_period AS analysisPeriod, recommendation.card_product_id AS cardProductId, recommendation.recommendation_rank AS recommendationRank, recommendation.expected_benefit_amount AS expectedBenefitAmount, recommendation.ai_recommendation_summary AS aiRecommendationSummary, product.card_name AS cardName, product.card_type AS cardType, product.card_description AS cardDescription, product.card_image AS cardImage, product.application, product.annual_fee AS annualFee FROM card_recommendation_tbl recommendation INNER JOIN kb_card_product_tbl product ON recommendation.card_product_id = product.card_product_id INNER JOIN spending_analysis_tbl analysis ON recommendation.spending_analysis_id = analysis.spending_analysis_id WHERE recommendation.card_recommendation_id = #{cardRecommendationId} AND analysis.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT detail.card_recommendation_detail_id AS cardRecommendationDetailId, detail.card_benefit_id AS cardBenefitId, benefit.spending_category_id AS spendingCategoryId, category.category_name AS categoryName, benefit.benefit_name AS benefitName, benefit.benefit_amount AS benefitAmount, benefit.benefit_rate AS benefitRate, benefit.monthly_limit AS monthlyLimit, benefit.minimum_spending_amount AS minimumSpendingAmount, benefit.benefit_description AS benefitDescription, detail.eligible_spending_amount AS eligibleSpendingAmount, detail.eligible_transaction_count AS eligibleTransactionCount, detail.eligible_month_count AS eligibleMonthCount, detail.expected_benefit_amount AS expectedBenefitAmount FROM card_recommendation_detail_tbl detail INNER JOIN card_benefit_tbl benefit ON detail.card_benefit_id = benefit.card_benefit_id INNER JOIN spending_category_tbl category ON benefit.spending_category_id = category.spending_category_id WHERE detail.card_recommendation_id = #{cardRecommendationId} ORDER BY detail.expected_benefit_amount DESC, detail.card_recommendation_detail_id ASC
